json_patch.value: Fix: fix(utilities): keep rwlock ownership when acquire is interrupted. Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/utilities/rw_lock.py, lib/crewai/tests/utilities/events/test_rw_lock.py. `r_locked()` and `w_locked()` called acquire inside the `try` that always releases in `finally`. If `Condition.wait()` is interrupted before acquire finishes, the context manager releases a lock it never held. The reader count can drop below zero, and the writer flag can be cleared while another writer still owns the lock. (Ref: https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI/pull/7944)
